demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Financial performance during the year was influenced by volatility in the prices of key raw materials, particularly cotton and synthetic fibres, which resulted in higher production costs.
- The Indian textile industry is expected to benefit from rising domestic consumption, increasing global demand for Indian textile products, and diversification of global sourcing.
- Growing demand for value-added, specialized and performance-oriented textile products presents opportunities for product diversification and improved realization.
- Government initiatives (PM MITRA Parks, PLI Scheme, National Technical Textiles Mission) are expected to support investment, technology adoption and manufacturing competitiveness in the textile sector.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Fluctuations in the prices of key raw materials, particularly cotton and synthetic fibres, resulted in higher production costs during the year; any substantial increase may impact cost of production and margins.
- The Company operates in a dynamic and competitive textile industry and remains exposed to changing customer preferences and competitive pricing pressures.
- Business performance is exposed to volatility in both domestic and international markets.
- Changes in economic conditions, regulatory requirements, foreign exchange movements and global trade dynamics may impact demand, costs and profitability.
- Continuous developments in manufacturing processes, machinery and product technology require the Company to evaluate and adopt improvements; failure to keep pace may affect operational efficiency, product quality and competitiveness.
- Performance may be influenced by inflation, interest rates, foreign exchange movements, changes in consumer spending and geopolitical developments, affecting both domestic demand and export opportunities.
- The Company's export turnover declined to Rs. 1,049.17 Lakhs from Rs. 1,443.98 Lakhs in the previous year, reflecting reliance on a set of international markets (South Korea, Thailand, Czech Republic, Denmark, Bangladesh, Egypt, Nepal) susceptible to trade-policy and geopolitical shifts.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening operational efficiency through cost optimisation and process enhancements.
- Strengthening presence in existing international export markets while exploring new export geographies.
- Focus on employee engagement, skill development and welfare initiatives.
- Continued evaluation of relevant technological developments and opportunities for product diversification.
